title: Proposal: avoid having to use the underlying SearchParameters implementation
body:
We have API entries requiring users to know the internal format of the SearchParameters data structure (helper "internal" implementation):
- searchParameters option
- widget.getConfiguration implementation (you need to return SearchParameters)

This is particulary tricky for faceting parameters. The helper defines structures that are not part of the REST API (disjunctive facets, hierarchical facets). For regular search parameters we are good.

As discussed IRL we should avoid those and prefer helper.\* methods as being the only needed API to understand.

Thus, I propose to:
- remove searchParameters option (need to be doable, maybe with #1031)
- remove widget.getConfiguration, ultimately we might just really need widget.init

comments.body: This is going away in react-instantsearch, soon in IS
